# Fundraising

## Overview
This wiki page covers fundraising efforts and [investor updates](./investor-updates.md) for [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md), as outlined in the draft investor update from July 2026 authored by CEO [Mira Chen](./aurora-labs.md). The company is actively pursuing capital to support its [hardware](./hardware.md) production and software scaling needs.

## Key Details
- **Current Ask:** Aurora Labs is seeking a $500k bridge financing round dedicated to injection mold tooling and adding 2 FTE [firmware](./firmware.md) engineers.
- **Traction Metrics:**
  - 47 beta [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) units currently deployed in the field.
  - MeshSync 0.3.8 successfully shipped, featuring a rejoin fix that unblocks 8-node deployments.
  - A [wiki compiler](./wiki-compiler.md) demo impressed a seed investor, drawing a mention of the "karpathy pattern."
- **Challenges & Mitigations:**
  - IP65 tooling ($8k) has been deferred; the company is shipping IP54 beta units with clear splash-resistance language instead.
  - Competitor [SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md) maintains an advantage in the outdoor waterproof narrative with its IP67 rating.
  - [Documentation](./documentation.md) contradiction regarding [battery life](./battery-life.md) claims (2 years vs. 18 months), which will be addressed by publishing a [power budget](./power-budget.md) spreadsheet in Q3.
- **Ecosystem & Community ([TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md) Tangent):**
  - Alex Kim reached out regarding co-marketing at Maker Faire, which was deferred until the Aurora beta ships.
  - There is no firmware merge with TeaBuddy, only a shared CR2032 supply chain joke.

## Related Entities
- **Aurora Labs:** The primary entity conducting the fundraising and developing the Nova Widget.
- **Mira Chen:** CEO of Aurora Labs and author of the investor update draft.
- **Alex Kim:** Reached out regarding co-marketing at Maker Faire.
- **TeaBuddy:** External entity associated with Alex Kim.
- **SenseNode (SN-400):** Competitor product noted for its outdoor waterproof IP67 narrative.

## Related Concepts
- **Bridge Financing:** The $500k fundraising mechanism targeted for injection molds and personnel.
- **MeshSync:** Proprietary software (version 0.3.8) critical to deployment scaling.
- **Documentation Reconciliation:** Resolving internal contradictions regarding battery longevity.
- **Tooling Mitigation:** Shifting from IP65 to IP54 tooling to manage upfront costs.
